content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_tracking case, overlaying a Lagrangian tracking trajectory on eta, vorticity and depth panels. Loads ../bathy/depth_a15.txt into dep1 (L5) then crops to hard-coded m=312, n=100 (L8-L9, L13; automatic sizing commented at L7); dx=1, dy=2 (L10-L11). Snapshot range fixed to nstart=nend=10 (L22-L23; interactive input commented L19-L20; legacy comment L25). Per snapshot (L28-L107): loads umean_, vmean_, eta_, mask_ (L33-L36) and the tracking output files tk_x.txt and tk_y.txt (L37-L38), masks eta/dep/u/v where mask<1 (L40-L44). Three panels with ax=[0 250 0 200] (L46): (1) eta pcolor caxis [-0.6 1.2] with the track's second column plotted as a white dashed curve plot(xt(:,2),yt(:,2)) (L49-L63, track L57); (2) vorticity from curl with widened caxis [-.1 .1] (L68-L71), dashed reference line at x=140 (L78) and the track again (L80); (3) depth contourf (caxis set twice, [-12 0] L88 then [-12 2.5] L93) with black quiver of u,v subsampled every 6 points scaled s=20 (L95-L98) and the track a third time (L101). pause(0.1) per frame (L106); nothing saved.
entities: h_bar colorbar handle L54, L72, L89
unresolved: only column 2 of tk_x/tk_y is plotted (L57, L80, L101); the number of tracked particles (columns) and the meaning of column 1 (time or particle 1) are not determinable from this file

the crop to m=312, n=100 (L8-L9, L13) presumes depth_a15.txt is at least that large; the rip_tracking makebath.m produces n=100 rows (ncell=2, ycell=100, dy=2) and m=312 columns (x=-11..300, dx=1), so the 'crop' actually spans the whole array — hard-coding appears to be a workaround for the commented size() line (L7)
tk_x.txt/tk_y.txt are loaded inside the snapshot loop (L37-L38) though they do not depend on num
dep masked in-place accumulates NaN across frames (single-frame here since nstart=nend=10); duplicate caxis for panel 3 (L88, L93)
